items.source: Create a new MetadataNamingStrategy which needs to be configured through the setAttributeSource(JmxAttributeSource) method.
items.translation: 创建一个新的MetadataNamingStrategy，需要通过setAttributeSource(JmxAttributeSource)方法进行配置。

items.source: Uses the JmxAttributeSource strategy interface, so that metadata can be read using any supported implementation. Out of the box, AnnotationJmxAttributeSource introspects a well-defined set of annotations that come with Spring.
items.translation: 使用 `JmxAttributeSource` 策略接口，以便可以使用任何支持的实现来读取元数据。开箱即用，`AnnotationJmxAttributeSource` 会检查 Spring 自带的一组定义明确的注解。

items.source: Create a new MetadataNamingStrategy for the given JmxAttributeSource.
Reads the ObjectName from the source-level metadata associated with the managed resource's Class.
items.translation: 读取与托管资源的 `Class` 关联的源级元数据中的 `ObjectName`。

items.source: Set the implementation of the JmxAttributeSource interface to use when reading the source-level metadata.
items.translation: 设置读取源级元数据时使用的 `JmxAttributeSource` 接口实现。

items.source:
The default is to use the domain specified in the bean name
(if the bean name follows the JMX ObjectName syntax); else,
the package name of the managed bean class.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用 bean 名称中指定的域（如果 bean 名称遵循 JMX ObjectName 语法）；否则，使用托管 bean 类的包名。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。

items.source:
Specify the default domain to be used for generating ObjectNames
when no source-level metadata has been specified.
items.translation: 指定在尚未指定源代码级别元数据时，用于生成 ObjectNames 的默认域。
`getObjectName` 接口 `ObjectNamingStrategy` 中

items.source: MalformedObjectNameException - if the resulting ObjectName is invalid
items.translation: MalformedObjectNameException - 如果生成的 ObjectName 无效

items.source: managedBean - the bean that will be exposed under the returned ObjectName
items.translation: managedBean - 将在返回的 ObjectName 下暴露的 Bean。

items.source: beanKey - the key associated with this bean in the beans map passed to the MBeanExporter
items.translation: beanKey - 此键与传递给 MBeanExporter 的 beans map 中的该 bean 相关联
